title: Simulacro Tarea 1: Gobierno, legislación y participación ciudadana (10 preguntas del examen)

words.translation: Parliamentary Monarchy (political form of the Spanish State, Art. 1.3 CE)
national sovereignty (resides in the Spanish people, Art. 1.2 CE)
General Courts / Spanish Parliament (Congress of Deputies + Senate)
Moncloa Palace (official residence and office of the Prime Minister)
Zarzuela Palace (residence of the King and Royal Family in Madrid)
Ombudsman (High Commissioner of the Cortes Generales defending citizens' rights)
Constitutional Court (12 members; supreme interpreter of the Constitution)
Official State Gazette (BOE, where laws enter into force)
